papers.title: Cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) binds talin and is anchored at the postsynaptic density by direct PDZ interactions.
papers.title_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶样蛋白5（CDKL5）与塔林蛋白结合，并通过直接的PDZ相互作用锚定在突触后密度处。
papers.abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) is a serine/threonine kinase essential for brain development and function. Mutations in CDKL5 cause CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD), a severe early-onset epileptic encephalopathy associated with impaired synapse formation and function. However, how CDKL5 mutations disrupt synaptic function remains unclear. Here, we show that the major neuronal isoform of CDKL5 contains a C-terminal PDZ domain-binding motif that mediates direct binding to PSD-95 and SHANK PDZ domains and recruits CDKL5 to the postsynaptic density. Disrupting this motif mislocalized CDKL5, reduced dendritic spine density, and impaired spine maturation. We also show that the CDKL5 kinase domain binds the R8 rod domain of the mechanosensitive scaffold talin. Mutation of the talin-binding interface or reduced cellular contractility altered CDKL5 positioning relative to focal adhesions. These findings define how CDKL5 is targeted to synapses, suggest that talin mechanoswitching may position CDKL5 kinase activity, and highlight the importance of C-terminal anchoring for interpreting pathogenic truncations.
papers.abstract_zh:
细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶样蛋白5（CDKL5）是一种丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，对大脑的发育和功能至关重要。CDKL5的突变会导致CDKL5缺陷性疾病（CDD），这是一种与突触形成和功能受损相关的严重早发性癫痫性脑病。然而，CDKL5突变如何破坏突触功能仍不清楚。在此，我们展示了CDKL5的主要神经元亚型含有C末端PDZ结构域结合基序t
该基序介导与PSD-95和SHANK PDZ结构域的直接结合，并将CDKL5招募到突触后密度。破坏该基序会导致CDKL5定位异常、树突棘密度降低以及棘成熟受损。我们还表明，CDKL5激酶结构域与机械敏感性支架蛋白talin的R8杆状结构域结合。talin结合界面的突变或细胞收缩力的降低改变了CDKL5相对于粘着斑的位置。T
这些发现阐明了CDKL5如何靶向突触，表明塔林蛋白的机械开关可能定位CDKL5激酶活性，并强调了C末端锚定对于解释致病性截短的重要性。

papers.title: Dopamine dynamics in a mouse model of temporal lobe seizures with impaired consciousness.
papers.title_zh: 颞叶癫痫伴意识障碍小鼠模型中的多巴胺动力学。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Focal temporal lobe seizures often lead to impaired consciousness. Recent work has shown depressed cortical arousal, with slow waves and decreased cortical acetylcholine as a possible mechanism for impaired consciousness in focal seizures. However, the role of other key subcortical arousal systems such as dopamine is largely unknown. We aimed to address this gap by investigating dopamine dynamics in a mouse model of focal limbic seizures with impaired behavioral responsiveness.
METHODS: We induced focal limbic seizures by brief electrical hippocampal stimulation in awake head-fixed mice with hippocampal and cortical local field potential recordings. Behavior was assessed by a conditioned auditory response task. We measured cortical dopamine with a genetically encoded fluorescent sensor via fiber photometry. Activity of dopaminergic neurons in the ventral tegmental area (VTA) was recorded by calcium measurements.
RESULTS: Focal hippocampal seizures were associated with altered cortical electrophysiological activity and impaired behavioral responsiveness. During seizures, we found sustained increases in dopamine in both medial prefrontal and orbital frontal cortex. We also found increased dopaminergic neuronal activity in the VTA during seizures. Despite these sustained increases, transient task-evoked dopaminergic increases in both cortex and VTA were reduced during seizures. Behavioral responses during seizures were reduced, and auditory stimuli without behavioral responses elicited smaller transient VTA dopaminergic signals compared to stimuli with preserved responses.
SIGNIFICANCE: Together, those results reveal distinct dysregulation of dopamine dynamics across sustained and fast time scales during focal limbic seizures. The sustained increases in dopamine suggest that the altered cortical function and impaired consciousness in focal limbic seizures may more closely resemble encephalopathy or delirium than deep sleep. Depressed transient dopamine release with sensory stimuli could also contribute to impaired behavioral responsiveness during seizures. Further work on the role of dopamine could have important therapeutic implications for altered cognition and behavior in people with epilepsy.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：颞叶局灶性癫痫发作通常会导致意识障碍。最近的研究表明，皮质觉醒抑制、慢波和皮质乙酰胆碱减少可能是局灶性癫痫发作中意识受损的可能机制。然而，其他关键皮层下觉醒系统（如多巴胺）的作用在很大程度上尚不清楚。我们的目标是通过研究边缘系统局灶性癫痫小鼠模型中的多巴胺动力学来填补这一空白。
行为反应受损。
方法：我们对清醒的头部固定的海马和皮层局部场电位记录小鼠进行短暂的海马电刺激，诱发局灶性边缘性癫痫发作。通过条件性听觉反应任务评估行为。我们使用遗传编码的荧光传感器通过光纤光度法测量了皮层多巴胺。腹侧被盖区（VTA）多巴胺能神经元的活动
如钙测量所记录。
结果：海马灶性癫痫发作与皮层电生理活动改变和行为反应受损相关。在癫痫发作期间，我们发现内侧前额叶皮层和眶额叶皮层的多巴胺持续增加。我们还发现，在癫痫发作期间，VTA中的多巴胺能神经元活性增加。尽管存在这些持续性增加，但任务诱发的短暂性多巴胺能增加
癫痫发作期间，大脑皮层和VTA的兴奋性均降低。癫痫发作期间的行为反应减弱，与保留行为反应的刺激相比，没有行为反应的听觉刺激诱发的瞬时VTA多巴胺能信号较小。
意义：这些结果共同揭示了在局灶性边缘系统癫痫发作期间，多巴胺动力学在持续和快速时间尺度上的明显失调。多巴胺的持续增加
表明局灶性边缘系统癫痫发作中皮层功能改变和意识受损可能更像脑病或谵妄，而不是深度睡眠。在有感觉刺激的情况下，短暂多巴胺释放的抑制也可能导致癫痫发作期间行为反应受损。对多巴胺作用的进一步研究可能对癫痫患者认知和行为的改变具有重要的治疗意义。

papers.title: Clinical predictors of monogenic aetiology and pharmacotherapy burden in drug-resistant focal epilepsy: Who benefits most from whole exome sequencing?
papers.title_zh: 耐药性局灶性癫痫的单基因病因和药物治疗负担的临床预测因素：谁最能从全外显子组测序中受益？
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Whole exome sequencing (WES) is of diagnostic value in focal drug-resistant epilepsy (FDRE) but is costly and not universally available. Identifying the clinical, imaging and electrophysiological features that predict a monogenic aetiology - and the determinants of pharmacotherapy burden - would allow rational selection of candidates for testing. We addressed both questions in a well-phenotyped Indian FDRE cohort.
METHODS: One hundred and twenty-five patients with ILAE-defined FDRE underwent phenotyping and proband WES. Variants of uncertain significance (VUS) were re-evaluated against ACMG/AMP combining rules. Patients with a pathogenic or likely pathogenic (P/LP) variant (n = 12) were compared with WES-negative patients (n = 84); patients with only VUS (n = 29) were considered undiagnosed and described separately. Groups were compared using the Mann-Whitney U test (epilepsy-related variables) and Fisher's exact test (categorical features). Multiple linear regression identified independent predictors of the number of concurrent anti seizure medications (ASMs), and multivariable Firth-penalised logistic regression examined predictors of a P/LP diagnosis; effect sizes accompanied univariable associations.
RESULTS: After reclassification, WES identified a P/LP variant in 12 patients (9.6 %); a further 29 (23.2 %) carried only VUS. No epilepsy-related variable (age of onset, epilepsy duration, seizure frequency, seizure-free interval, or ASM count) differed between P/LP and WES-negative patients. No categorical feature differed significantly: abnormal developmental history (42 % vs 21 %; OR 2.62, p = 0.152), positive family history (33 % vs 21 %; OR 1.83, p = 0.462) and intellectual deficits (25 % vs 15 %; OR 1.82, p = 0.415) were numerically more frequent in P/LP patients. Diagnostic yield was 14.7 % with abnormal development and 12.5 % with a positive family history, versus 7.7 % and 8.6 % in their absence. The number of concurrent ASMs was independently predicted by intellectual deficit (β = 0.813, p = 0.002) and log seizure frequency (β = 0.192, p = 0.030), but not by a P/LP variant (β = - 0.377, p = 0.261) or a VUS (β = - 0.316, p = 0.192). ASM adverse effects were infrequent (15/125) and unrelated to genetic status.
CONCLUSIONS: Clinical presentation does not reliably distinguish patients with a P/LP diagnosis from WES-negative patients with FDRE. Abnormal development, family history and intellectual disability showed only non-significant enrichment of diagnostic yield in this P/LP group and require validation in larger cohorts. Pharmacotherapy burden was associated with intellectual disability and seizure frequency but was not explained by WES results.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：全外显子组测序（WES）在局灶性难治性癫痫（FDRE）的诊断中具有重要价值，但成本高昂且并非普遍可用。确定可预测单基因病因的临床、影像学和电生理学特征，以及药物治疗负担的决定因素，将有助于合理选择检测候选人。我们在一个表型特征明确的印度FDRE队列中研究了这两个问题。
方法：一百名
25名符合ILAE定义的FDRE患者接受了表型分析和先证者WES检测。根据ACMG/AMP组合规则，对意义不确定的变异（VUS）进行了重新评估。将具有致病性或疑似致病性（P/LP）变异的患者（n = 12）与WES阴性患者（n = 84）进行比较；仅具有VUS的患者（n = 29）被视为未确诊，并单独描述。使用Mann-Whitney U检验对各组进行比较（癫痫
相关变量）和Fisher精确检验（分类特征）。多元线性回归确定了同时使用抗癫痫药物（ASM）数量的独立预测因素，多变量Firth惩罚性Logistic回归分析了P/LP诊断的预测因素；效应量伴随单变量关联。
结果：重新分类后，WES在12例患者（9.6%）中鉴定出P/LP变异；另外29例（23.2%）为携带者。
仅发现VUS。P/LP患者和WES阴性患者之间没有癫痫相关变量（发病年龄、癫痫病程、癫痫发作频率、无癫痫发作期或抗癫痫药物数量）存在差异。没有分类特征存在显著差异：P/LP患者中发育史异常（42% vs 21%；OR 2.62，p = 0.152）、家族史阳性（33% vs 21%；OR 1.83，p = 0.462）和智力缺陷（25% vs 15%；OR 1.82，p = 0.415）的发生率在数值上更高，
/LP患者。存在发育异常的诊断率为14.7%，存在阳性家族史的诊断率为12.5%，而不存在发育异常和阳性家族史的诊断率分别为7.7%和8.6%。同时使用ASM的数量可由智力缺陷（β = 0.813，p = 0.002）和对数癫痫发作频率（β = 0.192，p = 0.030）独立预测，但不能由P/LP变异（β = - 0.377，p = 0.261）或VUS（β = - 0.316，p = 0.192）预测。ASM不良反应并不常见（15/125），且与
d 遗传状态。
结论：临床表现无法可靠地区分P/LP诊断患者与WES阴性的FDRE患者。在该P/LP组中，发育异常、家族史和智力障碍仅显示诊断率的非显著性富集，需要更大规模的队列进行验证。药物治疗负担与智力障碍和癫痫发作频率相关，但未得到解释。

papers.title: Validation and reliability of the Epilepsy Self-Stigma Scale (ESSS) in Italian.
papers.title_zh: 意大利语版癫痫自我污名化量表（ESSS）的效度和信度。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Self-stigma is the interiorization and acceptance of prejudicial beliefs of one person's culture of origin. Higher levels of self-stigma in epilepsy negatively affect quality of life and outcome.
METHODS: We investigated self-stigma in people with epilepsy (PwE) in Italy, by translating, culturally adapting and validating the Italian version of the Epilepsy Self-Stigma Scale (ESSS). For psychometric validation, the scale (together with GAD7, NDDI-E, QOLIE31 and RSES) was filled-in by 87 adult PwE anonymously and voluntarily participating to an online survey broadcasted on "Fondazione Epilessia LICE ETS" social media. Clinical and demographic data were collected.
RESULTS: Internal consistency was good (Cronbach's α = 0.74). Reliability was high (Omega Total = 0.87). Higher stigma scores were moderately associated with greater anxiety (GAD-7; ρ = 0.43, p < 0.001) and depressive symptoms (NDDI-E; ρ = 0.39, p < 0.001). Negative correlations were observed with self-esteem (RSES; r = -0.45, p < 0.001) and quality of life (QOLIE-31; ρ = -0.42, p < 0.001). Individuals with lower levels of independence showed higher stigma scores.
SIGNIFICANCE: The 8-item Italian version of ESSS is valid and reliable. The findings suggest self-stigma is closely associated with quality of life through psychological factors, particularly self-esteem, although relationships should be interpreted cautiously given the cross-sectional design.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：自我污名化是指将一个人原生文化的偏见观念内化并接受。癫痫患者自我污名化程度较高会对生活质量和预后产生负面影响。
方法：我们通过翻译、文化适应和验证意大利版癫痫自我污名化量表（ESSS），对意大利癫痫患者（PwE）的自我污名化进行了调查。为了进行心理计量学验证，该量表（连同
GAD7、NDDI-E、QOLIE31和RSES）由87名成年癫痫患者匿名并自愿填写，他们参与了在“Fondazione Epilessia LICE ETS”社交媒体上发布的在线调查。收集了临床数据和人口统计学数据。
结果：内部一致性良好（Cronbach's α = 0.74）。信度较高（总Omega系数 = 0.87）。更高的污名化评分与更严重的焦虑（GAD-7；ρ = 0.43，p < 0.001）和抑郁
症状（NDDI-E；ρ = 0.39，p < 0.001）。观察到与自尊（RSES；r = -0.45，p < 0.001）和生活质量（QOLIE-31；ρ = -0.42，p < 0.001）呈负相关。独立性水平较低的个体表现出更高的污名化得分。
意义：8项意大利版ESSS具有效度和信度。研究结果表明，自我污名化通过心理因素（特别是自我效能感）与生活质量密切相关。
虽然鉴于横断面设计，应谨慎解释这些关系。

papers.title: Rituximab-responsive epilepsia partialis continua in autoimmune Polyendocrine syndrome: A video-EEG-EMG polygraphic study.
papers.title_zh: 自身免疫性多内分泌综合征中利妥昔单抗有反应的持续性局灶性癫痫：一项视频-脑电图-肌电图多导联研究。
papers.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
papers.abstract: Epilepsia partialis continua (EPC) is a rare and challenging form of focal motor status epilepticus. Its occurrence strictly in systemic autoimmune disorders without overt encephalitis is exceptional. Corticosteroids are first-line therapy but may be limited by significant side effects and poor metabolic tolerability. We report a 54-year-old woman with Autoimmune Polyendocrine Syndrome (APS), including autoimmune hepatitis, latent autoimmune diabetes in adults, celiac disease, and hypothyroidism, presenting with continuous jerks of right III-V fingers. Neurological examination showed continuous, irregular jerks confined to the right III, IV, and V fingers. Extensive serum and CSF screenings, including neuronal antibodies, and MRI were unremarkable. Ictal HMPAO-SPECT revealed a focal hyperperfusion in the left hand-knob area of the primary motor cortex. Brain FDG-PET revealed focal hypometabolism in the same region. Video-EEG-EMG polygraphy showed intermittent spikes and polyspikes over the left central region preceding EMG bursts of the right V finger's abductor muscle with a latency of approximately 30-40 ms. These findings were consistent with EPC. Corticosteroids induced marked improvement but were discontinued due to severe glycemic worsening. Subsequent treatment with oral steroids, IVIG, and multiple antiseizure medications were ineffective. Administration of Rituximab led to complete and sustained clinical and electrophysiological remission, which persisted at the 18-month follow-up. EPC can be a severe, focal manifestation of systemic autoimmunity even without encephalitis. Rituximab represents an effective steroid-sparing option for refractory autoimmune EPC, particularly in metabolically vulnerable patients.
papers.abstract_zh:
持续性局灶性癫痫（EPC）是一种罕见且棘手的局灶性运动性癫痫持续状态。它严格意义上仅在无明显脑炎的全身性自身免疫性疾病中发生，这种情况极为罕见。皮质类固醇是一线治疗药物，但可能因显著的副作用和代谢耐受性差而受到限制。我们报告了一名54岁女性患者，患有自身免疫性多内分泌综合征（APS），包括自身免疫性肝炎、潜伏性自身免疫性糖尿病。
成人糖尿病、乳糜泻和甲状腺功能减退症，表现为右侧第三至第五指持续性抽搐。神经系统检查显示，右手中指、无名指和小指有持续性、不规则的抽搐。包括神经元抗体在内的广泛血清和脑脊液筛查以及MRI检查均未见异常。发作期HMPAO-SPECT显示原发运动皮层左手掌丘区域存在局灶性高灌注。脑FDG-PET显示局灶性低代谢。
同一区域的代谢。视频-脑电图-肌电图多导联监测显示，在右侧小指外展肌肌电图爆发前，左侧中央区域出现间歇性尖波和多尖波，潜伏期约为30-40毫秒。这些发现与EPC一致。皮质类固醇诱导了显著的改善，但由于血糖严重恶化而停用。随后使用口服类固醇、IVIG和多种抗癫痫药物进行治疗，
无效。利妥昔单抗的给药导致了完全且持续的临床和电生理缓解，这种缓解在18个月的随访中持续存在。即使没有脑炎，EPC也可能是全身性自身免疫的严重局灶性表现。利妥昔单抗是一种有效的激素减量治疗方案，适用于难治性自身免疫性EPC，尤其是在代谢脆弱的患者中。

papers.title: Clinical outcomes and EEG monitoring in absence epilepsy trials: A narrative review.
papers.title_zh: 失神癫痫试验中的临床结局和脑电图监测：综述。
papers.abstract: Absence epilepsy is characterized by typical absence seizures with distinct electroclinical signatures. The main semiological feature is sudden behavioral arrest associated with brief impairment of consciousness, and the electroencephalographic (EEG) hallmark pattern is generalized, symmetric 2.5-4 Hz spike-and-wave discharges (GSW). Absence epilepsy diagnosis relies on correlating GSW with observable clinical manifestations. Monitoring therapeutic effects based solely on reported symptoms may be misleading, as behavioral arrest can be difficult to identify. Patients often do not recall most seizures, and observable motor/behavioral signs may be subtle, such as minimal twitches or transient lapses in responsiveness, which may go unnoticed. In clinical trials for absence epilepsies, quantification of GSW activity by EEG offers an objective and accurate measure of electrical burden and therapeutic efficacy. Despite technological limitations, GSW remains a robust neurophysiological endpoint. Increasing evidence indicates that the timing and burden of GSW correlate with epilepsy comorbidities, including attention, cognition, behavior, and sleep. We reviewed the published literature regarding GSW as an outcome measure in absence epilepsy, including nonseizure outcomes and comorbidities. Our review highlights (1) nearly 100% of clinical absence seizures exhibit sustained GSW discharges on EEG; (2) >49% of electrographic seizures are asymptomatic, indicating that reliance on seizure diaries without EEG monitoring underestimates seizure frequency and burden; (3) Genetic Generalized Epilepsy is not a benign condition and is associated with a high prevalence of cognitive and behavioral comorbidities, supporting evaluation beyond clinically observable seizures and the use of prolonged (≥24-h) EEG monitoring; (4) circadian and multidien cycles further emphasize the need for prolonged EEG recordings to reduce timing-related bias; and (5) antiseizure medications effective in absence epilepsy reduce GSW, supporting EEG monitoring as an objective treatment outcome measure. We therefore recommend incorporating ≥24-h EEG in future clinical trials, especially in (young) adults, and exploring comorbidities as important outcome measures. PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Absence epilepsy causes brief episodes in which a person suddenly stops what they are doing and may not be aware of their surroundings. Many of these seizures have no obvious signs and are often missed or forgotten, meaning seizure diaries alone do not show the full picture. Our review shows that brain recordings (electroencephalographic, EEG), especially when done over 24 h or longer, detect many unrecognized seizures and better measure how well treatments work. EEG findings are also linked to problems with attention, thinking, behavior, and sleep, highlighting the need to look beyond visible seizures when evaluating treatments in clinical trials.
papers.abstract_zh:
失神癫痫的特征是具有独特电临床特征的典型失神发作。主要的症状学特征是与短暂意识障碍相关的突然行为停顿，脑电图（EEG）的标志性模式是全身性、对称的2.5-4 Hz尖波-慢波发放（GSW）。失神癫痫的诊断依赖于将GSW与可观察到的临床表现联系起来。监测治疗
仅基于所报告症状的疗效评估可能具有误导性，因为行为停滞可能难以识别。患者通常不记得大多数癫痫发作，可观察到的运动/行为迹象可能很微妙，例如轻微的抽搐或短暂的反应迟钝，这些迹象可能被忽视。在失神癫痫的临床试验中，通过脑电图对GSW活动的定量分析提供了对电负荷和
治疗效果。尽管存在技术局限性，但GSW仍然是一个稳健的神经生理学终点。越来越多的证据表明，GSW的时间和负担与癫痫合并症相关，包括注意力、认知、行为和睡眠。我们回顾了关于GSW作为失神癫痫结局指标的已发表文献，包括非癫痫发作结局和合并症。我们的综述强调了以下几点：（1）近100%的临床
所有失神发作在脑电图上均表现出持续的GSW放电；(2) >49%的脑电图发作无症状，表明仅依靠发作日记而没有脑电图监测会低估发作频率和负担；(3) 遗传性全面性癫痫并非良性疾病，且与认知和行为合并症的高患病率相关，这支持在临床可观察到的发作之外进行评估，并使用预防性抗癫痫药物治疗。
（≥24小时）脑电图监测；（4）昼夜节律和多日节律进一步强调了进行长时间脑电图记录的必要性，以减少与时间相关的偏倚；（5）对失神癫痫有效的抗癫痫药物可减少GSW，从而支持将脑电图监测作为客观的治疗结局指标。因此，我们建议在今后的临床试验中纳入≥24小时的脑电图监测，特别是在（青年）成年人中，并探索将合并症作为重要的结局指标。
发作。通俗易懂的摘要：失神癫痫会导致短暂的发作，患者会突然停止正在做的事情，并且可能对周围环境毫无察觉。这些癫痫发作中有很多没有明显的征兆，往往会被忽视或遗忘，这意味着仅靠癫痫发作日记并不能全面反映情况。我们的综述表明，脑电记录（脑电图，EEG），特别是在24小时或更长时间内进行时，可以检测到许多未被识别的癫痫发作。
并更好地衡量治疗效果。脑电图结果还与注意力、思维、行为和睡眠方面的问题相关，这凸显了在临床试验中评估治疗方法时，需要着眼于可见癫痫发作之外的问题。

papers.title: Intrarater reliability of expert electroencephalographic interpretation of 100 full-length recordings.
papers.title_zh: 专家对100份完整脑电图记录的判读者内一致性。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: The value of electroencephalography (EEG) relies on accurate and reliable interpretation. Prior research has demonstrated imperfect interrater reliability, but intrarater reliability remains poorly characterized. We performed a "noise audit" primarily to measure intrarater variability in EEG interpretation by epileptologists.
METHODS: Experts independently rated the same 100 full-length EEGs on two separate occasions ≥60 days apart, unaware the EEGs were the same. EEGs were recorded from adult (56%) and pediatric patients in outpatient (78%) and non-critical care inpatient settings. There were 20 studies in each of five categories: normal, focal epileptiform (FE), generalized epileptiform (GE), focal nonepileptiform (FNE), and generalized nonepileptiform (GNE) abnormalities. EEGs were presented using our online platform (EEGHub) without clinical information except for age and sex. Experts rated each recording and indicated their level of confidence (LOC) for each EEG and overall. We analyzed percent as well as chance-corrected intra- and interrater agreement.
RESULTS: Fourteen experts (mean of 19 years EEG reading experience, range = 4-52 years) were included in the study. Percent self-agreement was 96% for GE, 90% for FE, 88% for FNE, and 87% for GNE abnormalities; 90% for any epileptiform abnormality; and 82% for any nonepileptiform abnormality. Self-agreement was strongly correlated with interrater agreement (mean κML), which was almost perfect for GE (.90, 95% confidence interval [CI] = .87-.94) and FE (.82, 95% CI = .77-.87) and substantial for GNE (.75, 95% CI = .69-.81) and FNE (.74, 95% CI = .68-.80) abnormalities. LOC correlated with self-agreement on the presence of nonepileptiform but not epileptiform abnormalities.
SIGNIFICANCE: We found generally strong within-expert agreement in EEG interpretation, especially in the identification of epileptiform abnormalities. Nevertheless, the number of flipped decisions was high enough to be clinically consequential. This undesired variability ("occasion noise") may be addressed by interventions to (1) decrease this noise directly and (2) reduce case ambiguity with longer recordings and better EEG data whenever feasible.

papers.title: Seizure freedom in a regional epilepsy cohort: associations with age, income, and education.
papers.title_zh: 局部性癫痫队列中的癫痫发作缓解：与年龄、收入和教育水平的关联。
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Seizure freedom is one of the most important outcomes in epilepsy. Historically, two-thirds of epilepsy patients achieve seizure freedom, but shifts in etiologies, ages, treatments, and care provision limit extrapolation to present conditions. Low socioeconomic position is associated with epilepsy severity; suggested bidirectional mechanisms include disparities in access, health literacy, or adherence and seizure control allowing employment. We asked what proportion of epilepsy patients achieve seizure freedom and aimed to describe associations with relative socioeconomic position.
METHODS: Regional study of adult patients enrolled between 2020-2024 (n = 575, median age 47) with follow-up for at least one year. Individual and household income and education level were obtained from nationwide registers for 2023. Seizure freedom for one year at last follow-up was determined from medical records or a participant survey. Cross-sectional associations between seizure freedom and age, epilepsy type, income and education were assessed using binary logistic regression.
RESULTS: 65.7% (95%CI:61.7-69.4) were seizure-free at last follow-up. Higher age and generalized epilepsy were associated with seizure freedom. Normalized household income was not associated with seizure freedom, but individual total and earned income and higher education were. Reported adherence to prescribed drugs was lower among seizure-free patients.
CONCLUSIONS: The proportion attaining seizure freedom was similar to previous reports. The associations with individual income and education were complex and the limitation of our cohort and the cross-sectional method preclude causal inference. Longitudinal studies are needed to assess whether socioeconomic position can identify patients who would benefit from closer clinical follow-up.

papers.title: Prediction of surgical outcome using cyclic spectral coherent networks of intracranial EEG signals.
papers.title_zh: 使用颅内脑电信号的循环谱相干网络预测手术结果。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Epilepsy is a network disorder characterized by abnormal brain connectivity. Identifying network-level biomarkers is critical for improving surgical outcome prediction and understanding seizure dynamics.
NEW METHODS: This study proposes a novel framework to assess the brain network organization of epileptic patients using cyclostationary-based connectivity matrices derived from intracranial EEG (iEEG) signals. The iEEG recordings of epileptic patients with surgical outcomes classified as Engel I (n=19) and Engel II+ (n=19) groups are considered for this study. Cyclic Spectral Coherence (CSC) based connectivity matrices are estimated from the preictal, ictal and postictal seizure phases using Welch's method. Further, network hubs are identified using centrality measures and the Resection Hub Alignment Degree (RHAD) metric is computed to quantify the alignment between the hubs and surgically resected nodes.
RESULTS: The results of the cyclostationary spectrum reveal non-zero spectral correlation density, confirming the presence of rhythmic patterns in iEEG signals with dominant peaks observed in the SOZ regions. Furthermore, preictal RHAD-EVC differentiates the seizure-free and non-seizure-free patient groups (p < 0.01) and achieves an AUC of 0.64 for postoperative surgical outcome prediction.
COMPARISON WITH EXISTING METHODS: The results of the proposed method are in good agreement with those reported in previous studies.
CONCLUSIONS: Overall, the cyclic spectral coherent network-based RHAD metric may serve as a robust index that captures the network disruptions beyond geometric overlap. The proposed framework demonstrates potential to serve as an ancillary tool for characterizing network alterations rather than as a standalone predictive indicator.

papers.title: Characterizing source-level electroencephalography activities to single-pulse TMS-EEG.
papers.title_zh: 对单脉冲TMS-EEG的源级脑电图活动进行表征。
papers.journal: Clinical neurophysiology : official journal of the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To distinguish active from sham single-pulse TMS responses over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) using source-level EEG, emphasizing target-region effects and exploratory whole-brain patterns.
METHODS: Thirty-three healthy adults underwent active and sham TMS-EEG. We assessed local TMS-evoked potentials (TEPs), electric-field simulations, and source-derived significant current density (SCD) and scattering (SCS). Target-region ROI analyses examined early (30-60 ms) and late (250-350 ms) responses; whole-brain differences were tested using cluster-based permutation tests. Peripheral EEG measures were evaluated before and after independent component analysis (ICA) and used as covariates.
RESULTS: Active stimulation produced larger early local TEPs than sham (2.15 ± 1.39 vs. 0.85 ± 0.66 μV; Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.001), a more negative N100, and a larger P200. Target-region SCS and SCD were greater with active stimulation in both windows (all adjusted p < 0.01). Whole-brain tests identified significant late SCS (275-333 ms) and SCD (269-374 and 271-366 ms) clusters, but no early clusters. Measured peripheral differences were nonsignificant after ICA. Covariate adjustment preserved the SCS and one SCD cluster, whereas the other SCD cluster was not significant after muscle-related adjustment.
CONCLUSIONS: Target-region source measures differentiated active from sham stimulation at early and late latencies, whereas significant whole-brain clusters were observed only at late latencies.
SIGNIFICANCE: Early source-level findings complement sensor-level TEPs, but late-stage source evidence requires cautious interpretation.

papers.title: The diastole-systole transition as a regulatory window for heart-brain coupling in major depressive disorder: Evidence from cardiac phase-dependent 1/f slope and periodic neural dynamics.
papers.title_zh: 舒张-收缩转换作为重度抑郁症中心脑耦合的调节窗口：来自心脏相位依赖性1/f斜率和周期性神经动力学的证据。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Cardiac rhythms dynamically modulate neural activity and information processing. Disruptions in heart-brain coupling (HBC) may contribute to affective dysregulation in major depressive disorder (MDD), yet their effects on periodic and aperiodic neural activity remain unclear. This study investigated cardiac cycle-dependent modulation of oscillatory and 1/f neural components in MDD.
METHODS: Resting-state magnetoencephalography (MEG) and electrocardiography (ECG) were simultaneously recorded from 60 patients with MDD and 60 matched healthy controls. Patients underwent a 6-month follow-up, and remission status was assessed using the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD-17). The Spectral Parameterization Resolved in Time (SPRiNT) algorithm was used to separate periodic and aperiodic neural activity. Linear mixed-effects models and permutation-based statistics were applied to examine cardiac phase-dependent neural modulation and between-group differences.
RESULTS: Cardiac phase modulated both oscillatory power and aperiodic 1/f dynamics. Compared with controls, patients with MDD exhibited attenuated steepening of the aperiodic 1/f spectrum in the left insula during the diastole-to-systole transition and a greater reduction in δ-band power in the left anterior cingulate cortex during late systole. In addition, patients with MDD showed earlier α-band peak activity in the posterior cingulate cortex. Exploratory longitudinal analyses showed an increase in left insular 1/f modulation within remitters, although the formal group × time interaction was not significant.
CONCLUSIONS: MDD is characterized by disrupted cardiac cycle-dependent neural dynamics involving both periodic and aperiodic activity. Altered insular aperiodic modulation may reflect impaired excitation-inhibition balance and abnormal heart-brain synchronization in depression, highlighting cardiac rhythms as potential state-dependent targets for closed-loop neuromodulation.

papers.title: A state-dependent glymphatic dimension in major depressive disorder: implications for treatment resistance.
papers.title_zh: 重度抑郁障碍中与状态相关的淋巴系统维度：对治疗耐药性的影响。
papers.abstract: The glymphatic system refers to cerebrospinal fluid-interstitial fluid exchange and proposed drainage pathways shaped by sleep, arousal, vascular dynamics, and astrocytic organization. This physiology offers a way to connect disturbances that often coexist in major depressive disorder (MDD): disrupted sleep, fatigue, cognitive slowing, and stress-related abnormalities. We propose that difficulty establishing or maintaining a coordinated sleep-astrocyte-vascular state may contribute to illness persistence in some patients. Treatment-resistant depression (TRD) provides a setting in which this possibility can be examined across the course of treatment. Preclinical studies link stress and depressive-like behavior to astrocytic injury, aquaporin-4 dysregulation, and altered fluid transport. Human imaging findings vary across depressive phenotypes. In a dedicated TRD study, a higher diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) ratio was partly driven by reduced denominator diffusivity, illustrating the importance of interpreting this indirect index at component level. Whole-brain spatiotemporal models provide a complementary account of the neural activity accompanying these physiological states. Ketamine/esketamine, transcranial magnetic stimulation, and chronobiological interventions offer different ways to investigate treatment-related change; serotonergic psychedelics provide an exploratory extension. Longitudinal studies can establish how changes in sleep, fluid-sensitive imaging, and neural dynamics relate temporally to clinical recovery. This Perspective therefore develops a potentially modifiable physiological dimension of persistent depressive illness and defines how it can be tested.

papers.title: Epistemic Challenges in the Interpretation of Brain Data: A Roadmap for Aligning Divergent Inferences.
papers.title_zh: 脑数据解释中的认识论挑战：协调不同推论的路线图。
papers.abstract: Advances in brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) and artificial intelligence enable the identification of neural signatures-patterns of brain activity linked to thoughts, emotions, and mental states. Next-generation BCIs, including adaptive deep brain stimulation, promise personalized treatment for movement and psychiatric conditions. However, their effectiveness depends on whether neural signatures accurately reflect individuals' experiences and clinical states. Because neural signatures are abstract, they require meaningful correlations with behavior, symptoms, and clinical outcomes. Ethical challenges arise when brain data, behavioral observations, and patient self-reports conflict, raising questions about whose knowledge matters and how to determine clinical "ground truth." We argue that neural signature research needs epistemic duty-the responsibility to make well-reasoned decisions using the best available evidence-and propose three strategies to address these challenges: contextual, dimensional approaches to integrate diverse data; involving patients in decisions about data use; and stress-testing neural models to assess their robustness under uncertainty and conflicting evidence.

papers.title: The somato-cognitive action network in parkinsonian gait dysfunction and closed-loop neuromodulation.
papers.title_zh: 帕金森步态障碍和闭环神经调控中的躯体-认知动作网络。
papers.abstract: Parkinsonian gait dysfunction and freezing of gait (FoG) emerge from interactions among motor, cognitive-control and neuromodulatory systems. The somato-cognitive action network (SCAN) adds an anatomically defined cortical component to these distributed accounts. This narrative review examines its contribution across disease associations, targeted perturbation, state-contingent treatment, and incremental clinical value. SCAN-subcortical hyperconnectivity in Parkinson's disease and its treatment sensitivity link inter-effector cortex to established disease circuits. A randomized comparison of individualized SCAN and effector-region intermittent theta-burst stimulation supports target-dependent improvement in total motor scores; FoG-specific efficacy remains unresolved because the axial outcome combined gait and non-gait items. In parallel, gait-phase and activity-dependent deep-brain stimulation demonstrate that neural signals can guide behaviorally timed treatment, with early benefits in selected gait outcomes. Across these accounts, neurochemical and distributed-network measures characterize vulnerability, while episode-linked decoupling identifies candidate state markers. SCAN contributes a more specific cortical hypothesis: transition-related activity in individually mapped SCAN may distinguish impending freezing beyond neighboring cortex and established gait signals. Cortical target selection and adaptive timing have separate empirical support; their combination is a proposed therapeutic strategy. Matched input and stimulation comparisons can determine whether SCAN adds predictive information or clinical benefit to existing controllers.

papers.title: A reproducible event-driven analytical framework for ECG-derived skin sympathetic nerve activity analysis: towards afferent signal processing for closed-loop neuromodulation.
papers.title_zh: 用于心电图衍生皮肤交感神经活动分析的可重复事件驱动分析框架：迈向闭环神经调节的传入信号处理。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Quantifying skin sympathetic nerve activity (SKNA) is challenging because sympathetic signals are noisy, burst-like, and processing-dependent. Electrocardiogram-derived skin sympathetic nerve activity (ECG-derived SKNA) provides a non-invasive surrogate of sympathetic activity. Many existing SKNA analysis methods rely on semi-manual processing or static measurements, with limited attention to dynamic event-based physiology, reproducibility across large cohorts, or near-real-time applications.
OBJECTIVE: To develop and evaluate a reproducible event-driven computational framework for analysing ECG-derived SKNA during transient sympathetic activation driven by simulated apnoeas, with potential application to future closed-loop neuromodulation.
METHODS: The framework integrates electrocardiography preprocessing, multi-channel SKNA extraction, adaptive burst detection, event-centred physiological analysis, and sequential replay. It was developed using recordings from 50 pigs during apnoeas induced by intermittent negative upper airway pressure (INAP). Adaptive thresholds were defined as the maximum of a two-component Gaussian mixture model intersection, the baseline 95th percentile, and a baseline variability criterion. Sequential offline replay was performed on the pre-processed SKNA, with each replay decision restricted to SKNA samples available up to that decision point. Burst occupancy was calculated in a 30-s trailing window updated every 10 s, with trigger activation requiring occupancy above 5% in two consecutive windows. The pipeline was also applied to an independent multi-event INAP recording.
RESULTS: During sequential replay, a trigger was present during INAP in 43 of 50 recordings (86%). Among the 49 recordings in which the detector was OFF at INAP onset, 42 (85.7%) developed a new post-onset trigger activation, with a median detection latency of 24.0 s (IQR 18.9-54.3 s). In the independent multi-event recording, all three INAP events generated replay triggers, with detection latencies of 28.4, 30.0, and 20.0 s. Continuous replay of an intervention recording also showed event-specific SKNA and trigger outputs before and during dorsal root ganglion (DRG) stimulation.
CONCLUSION: This study presents a reproducible event-driven framework for analysing SKNA. The framework captures heterogeneous SKNA responses and allows sequential evaluation as new SKNA samples become available. By enabling dynamic SKNA responses to be monitored during physiological perturbations, the framework provides a practical foundation for prospective real-time validation and future closed-loop neuromodulation using SKNA-derived physiological feedback.

papers.title: A glucose-powered artificial neuroimmune axis for metabolic control.
papers.title_zh: 一种用于代谢控制的葡萄糖驱动型人工神经免疫轴。
papers.abstract: Metabolic disorders such as diabetes mellitus are global health crises driven by metabolic imbalance, chronic inflammation and dysfunction of the neuroimmune axis1-3. Electroceuticals targeting the autonomic nervous system have shown anti-inflammatory effects, yet existing systems lack the metabolic interoceptive feedback to fully restore immune-metabolic homeostasis4-9. Here we report an artificial neuroimmune axis (NeuroAxis) as a closed-loop immunomodulatory therapy for treating metabolic diseases. Analogous to its biological counterpart, NeuroAxis is solely powered by endogenous glucose, operating without batteries or wireless power transfer. It emulates the vagal reflex through closed-loop neuromodulation with metabolic interoceptive feedback. In a rat model of type 1 diabetes, NeuroAxis promotes the recovery of insulin-producing pancreatic β-cells and reduces inflammatory immune responses; in a rat model of type 2 diabetes, it drives macrophage remodelling and reduces systemic chronic inflammation. In both models, NeuroAxis restores glucose tolerance, improves insulin sensitivity and normalizes glycaemic control, with therapeutic effects persisting after treatment cessation. Our artificial neuroimmune axis promotes substantial advances in treating metabolic disorders and represents a general approach for autonomously regulating interorgan communication, central to homeostasis and pathophysiology.
